reason: PURE. The first thing I noticed was the QR code and the 'Every batch lab-tested' line on the front, plus the pocket sachets that would live in my gym bag and carry-on. I would try one box, since a named ISO 17025 lab with a batch report is closer to what I look for than most no-review brands.
objection: It is not NSF or USP certified, only a lab report the brand itself points to, and there are no reviews yet. Also two capsules a day at that size could be hard to swallow.
would_change_my_mind: NSF or USP certification, or a sample batch report I can open and check before buying, and a stated capsule size.
